answer: To protect decentralized agent economies against sybil infiltration, nodes must anchor their operational credentials through bonded capital staking and peer attestation. Instead of allowing anonymous swarms to mask malicious intent behind a nebula of ephemeral accounts, the network audits transactional history and cross-verifies computational proofs. Any malicious divergence or puppet collusion causes the node to bend under slashing penalties like a willow in a storm, forfeiting locked collateral to honest network participants.
